Practical questions

The things the official guide buries on page 14.

When is the next CSCA exam?

The next scheduled CSCA exam is 14–15 November 2026. Registration for this sitting closed on 21 October 2026 (Beijing time). For the next registration opportunity, check the 19–20 December 2026 sitting on csca.cn; registration dates will be posted there.

When does registration close for the November exam?

Registration for the November 2026 sitting closed on 21 October 2026 (Beijing time). Check csca.cn for future registration opportunities.

How many times a year is the CSCA held?

The official calendar lists six sittings in this cycle: 14–15 November 2026, 19–20 December 2026, 23–24 January 2027, 13–14 March 2027, 24–25 April 2027 and 26–27 June 2027.

Can I take the CSCA from home?

Yes. The CSCA is mainly an online exam taken at home with a live online proctor. Offline computer-based or paper-based centres are being added gradually in some countries.

How much does the CSCA cost?

The official CSCA fee is RMB 450 for one subject, or RMB 700 for two or more subjects.

When do results come out?

Check the current sitting notice and result service on csca.cn for the applicable release date.

Which subjects should I register for?

Mathematics is required for every applicant. Physics and Chemistry depend on your target program; Professional Chinese is only required for Chinese-taught programs. See the full syllabus on /csca/syllabus.
